config.title: MLOps Interview Preparation
config.gateSub: Pick a profile and the catalogue reorders itself for your interview.
config.episodeBlurb: Every episode follows the same arc: Conceptual Deep Dive, Cross-Connection Scenarios, Production Anti-Patterns, Minimal Working Code and an Interview Angle with model answers.
config.episodeSub: Deep dive, scenarios, anti-patterns, code and interview angle
config.description: A senior-level MLOps interview preparation series: production ML platforms, monitoring, CI/CD/CT, serving, governance, runnable code and worked system-design answers.
config.footerNote: Open-source learning project. Code samples are syntax-checked; library calls may drift between versions, so verify against current docs. The storefront-style design is an homage to e-commerce sites: it uses no copied logos, ratings, reviews or prices (everything here is free and MIT-licensed), and this project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Flipkart.
